from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityEnrollmentRecord(BaseModel):
    """One university's enrollment data from a CDS report for calculating first-year reliance ratio."""
    university_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the university")
    first_year_freshmen_count: int | None = Field(description="Count of degree-seeking, first-time, first-year freshmen (numerator)")
    total_enrollment: int | None = Field(description="Grand Total All Students enrollment (denominator)")
    term_month: str | None = Field(description="The reporting term, in YYYY-MM format, e.g. '2021-09' for Fall 2021")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    university_records: list[UniversityEnrollmentRecord]
